ITA-8.3.21 yūṣaḥ यूषः
Soup of vegetables and /or pulses
A type of food preparation in which a soup of vegetables and/ or pulses is prepared by adding 16 parts water.

ITA-5.76.240 yūṣopayogajīrṇajvaraḥ यूषोपयोगजीर्णज्वरः/यूषोपयोगवातज्वरः
Condition due to use of gruel endstage of fever
